sn1.6:1.1: At Sāvatthī. Standing to one side, that devata recited this verse in the presence of the Blessed One:
sn1.6:1.2:
"How many are asleep when
are awake?
How many are awake when
sleep?
By how many does one gather dust?
By how many is one purified?"
"Five are asleep when
are awake;
Five are awake when
sleep.
By five things one gathers dust,
By five things one is purified."
